v.rationale: The three are structurally very close: impl-1 and impl-2 are near-identical, and all use Filament 5 Schemas/Tables classes, HasLabel/HasColor enums, a policy, a relation manager and a stats widget with TestAction-based tests. All three share one real bug: a non-admin can delete a customer, which cascades to delete their tickets. The decisive difference is resolved_at integrity. impl-3's observer stamps it on resolve and clears it on reopen through any path. In impl-1 and impl-2, resolving via the edit form leaves resolved_at null (probe confirmed), which silently skews the dashboard average. impl-3's remaining issues are cosmetic (combined migration, unused import), so it ranks first. impl-1 has the best tests and code polish but the resolved_at gap, so it is second. impl-2 has the same gap plus no unique customer email (probe created duplicates) and a minimal policy that only works inside Filament's lenient authorization, so it is third.
